summary: Wire the T-0118 KeyedDigest port from the startMain composition root into the request-path ResolverDeps. A single resolverDepsObj allocation (src/main.ts:134) is passed to createServer() AND returned on MainHandle.resolverDeps (object identity, R-2 fix). The purity fitness check (keyed-digest-core-purity.sh) is scoped to 3 masking modules with positive+negative self-tests (R-1 fix). createServer/buildRouter typed Partial<ResolverDeps> — no as-unknown-as cast (R-3 fix). 9/9 AC covered; 908/908 tests pass; 43/43 fitness checks green. Review approved (iteration 2, d7655fb). Dev gap = 8 commits (T-0145/T-0119/T-0039); rebase before merge is orchestrator's step.

backlog_candidates.title: Full no-env-in-core sweep: push flowable-client.ts env reads to composition root
backlog_candidates.description: src/core/flowable-client.ts:264/269/274 reads process.env[FLOWABLE_BASE_URL/USER/PASSWORD] directly. T-0143 could not scope its purity check to all of src/core/ because of these pre-existing reads. A separate task should refactor flowable-client.ts to accept its config via injected constructor parameters (or an options object), with env reads pushed up to src/main.ts. This completes the no-env-in-core invariant for all modules under src/core/.
